create_identity_bias_tensor: create an IdentityBias and call create_bias_tensor to produce a zero attention bias matrix
create_causal_attention_bias: create a CausalAttentionBias with optional window length and generate its causal bias tensor
create_chunked_attention_bias: create a ChunkedAttentionBias with a chunk size and generate its block-wise causal mask tensor
create_alibi_attention_bias: create an ALiBiAttentionBias for a given number of heads and generate linear positional bias slopes
materialize_attention_bias: materialize an AttentionBias into a full tensor using BatchLayout for packed or padded sequences
